meta.gameVersionNote: Most Classic data sites use Founder's Access / v0.9.0 data, last updated Oct 12-15 2026. Re-verify after the Oct 21 Grand Launch.
meta.confidenceKey: high = several Classic-specific sources agree; medium = one Classic source or partly inferred; low = pre-Big-Bang baseline, a single unverified claim, or content that is not live yet
meta.keyFinding: At launch Classic is Maple Island + Victoria Island only (incl. Sleepywood dungeons and Florina Beach). Orbis, El Nath, Ludibrium, Aqua Road and Leafre (all of Ossyria) are NOT in the game. Victoria Island runs out of level-appropriate monsters at about lv 55-60. The highest normal monster is Taurospear (lv 75), and the lv 80 Jr. Balrog is a boss. Training from 60 to 100 means over-leveled grinding on lv 48-62 maps. Per meowdb's EXP table, each level from 90 to 99 costs 2.1x the one before, and lv 99->100 alone costs about 9.48B EXP (52% of the 1-100 total), so lv 100 is effectively out of reach at launch.

regionsAvailable.notes: One-way exit: Shanks takes you to Lith Harbor at lv 7 for 300 mesos. Finish every quest before you leave.
Lith Harbor, Henesys, Ellinia, Perion, Kerning City (incl. Subway), Sleepywood (Ant Tunnel, Sleepy Dungeon, Drake areas, Sanctuary/Cursed Sanctuary), Florina Beach.

Monsters Lv 39-59 plus the Lv 60 Rotten Mushmom. Reached through The Tree Tunnel off The Forest North of Ellinia (quest 'Welcome to the Hollow', starts lv 39 with Grendel). Its group quest (lv 41+) arrives Dec 9. Metaroad's beginner guide lists it as available at launch, but meowdb's roadmap and Forgotten Hollow guide both say Nov 18. A second entrance opens from deep inside Sleepywood.
Being reworked; no release date. A 3rd-job test server is planned for early 2027. Orbis/El Nath data from the August test is only a historical snapshot.
No Classic source lists them as live. maplestoryguide.wiki explicitly excludes Ludibrium.

route.map: Maple Island quest chain plus Snail/Mushroom fields (Mushroom Garden, Dangerous Forest, fields around Amherst)
route.monsters: Snail, Blue Snail, Red Snail, Shroom, Orange Mushroom
route.tip: The 10 Maple Island quests take you to about lv 8. Pio's quest gives The Green Relaxer chair, which is only available here. Hand in everything before you take the boat.

route.map: Thicket Around the Beach I / II (Lith Harbor)
route.tip: Do the Lith Harbor quests and take a taxi to your job town while you are still a Beginner, because taxis are 90% off.

route.map: Tree Dungeon, Forest Up North IV (Ellinia) or West Rocky Mountain III (Perion)
route.tip: Start on Slimes and move to Green Mushrooms once you can 2-hit them. Alternatives are L Forest I (Ribbon Pig lv 10, near Kerning) and Henesys Hunting Ground (busy).

route.map: Henesys Hunting Ground I / Pig Beach / Construction Site North of Kerning City
route.monsters: Slime, Orange Mushroom, Pig, Ribbon Pig, Dark Stump
route.tip: These maps are good for melee and bowmen. HHG is often crowded, so switch channels.
A dense single-mob map two maps from Kerning, and the top EXP/hr pick in this range on several sites. Backup: Blue Mushroom Forest (Blue Mushroom lv 19, near Henesys).
Stirges fly, which favors ranged and magic attacks. Melee alternatives: Tree Dungeon Forest Up North III (Horny Mushroom 22) or East Rocky Mountain V (Dark Axe Stump 23).

route.map: Ant Tunnel III / Deep Ant Tunnel I / Ant Tunnel Park
route.monsters: Zombie Mushroom, Horny Mushroom, Evil Eye
route.tip: The highest-density solo maps for 21-30 (about 100 mobs per map). Zombie Mushrooms are undead and holy-weak. The VIP cab drops you at Ant Tunnel Park, but no cab takes you back, so stock potions in Sleepywood. Run KPQ in parallel if you have a party.

route.map: The Land of Wild Boar II (Perion) / Pig Park II (Henesys)
route.tip: A melee-friendly alternative to the Ant Tunnel. Dying here sends you back to Perion.

Take 2nd job at 30 first. Jr. Wraiths are undead, so Clerics excel here. Alternatives: Tree Dungeon Forest Up North IX (Curse Eye 33, Ellinia) for mages, or The Burnt Land V (Fire Boar 32) for warriors and bowmen.

route.map: A Look-Out Shed Around the Beach / Lorang Lorang (Florina Road)
route.tip: Alternatives: Monkey Swamp I (Lupin 37) or keep farming Jr. Wraiths. Ronnie's Cold Eye quest (lv 41, Ellinia) fits around here. In Founder's Access most players hunted Lorangs from about Lv 42, because accuracy scales with level.

route.map: Tree Dungeon, Monkey Forest II / Monkey Swamp III / Monkey Forest II
route.tip: Zombie Lupins have low defense, so these maps work with weaker gear. I/L Wizards can use Dangerous Valley (Copper Drake 45, ice-weak). The Tunnel That Lost Light I (Cold Eye 40) has lv 50 Drakes patrolling, so only strong characters should go there.

The highest theoretical EXP/hr map on Victoria Island at launch. Wraiths are undead. These maps are 6 maps from Kerning, so bring a big potion stack. Red Whip drops here. Non-subway alternatives: Hot Sand (Tortie 46, Clang 49) and Lorang and Clang (lightning mages get a bonus).

route.map: Dangerous Croko II / Drake Hunting Ground
route.tip: These maps have mobs closer to your level but fewer than half the Wraith-line density. Drake Hunting Ground is a party/loot spot (Dragon Skin). Founder's Access players mostly started Drakes around Lv 48.

route.map: Sleepy Dungeon V (or III) / The Forest of Evil II
route.region: Victoria Island - Sleepywood / Ellinia hidden street
route.monsters: Dark Stone Golem (58); Malady (55) + Zombie Lupin
route.tip: Sleepy Dungeon V has the most spawn points in the 56-60 bracket. Dark Stone Golem and Malady are holy-weak but not undead, so Heal won't hurt them. The Oct 15 patch thinned Sleepy Dungeon V's spawns a bit. meowdb's Assassin and Fighter guides send 55-70 characters to Forest of Evil II and Monkey Forest II.

route.map: Dangerous Valley II / Wild Kargo's Area
route.monsters: Red Drake (60); Wild Kargo (62) + Cold Eye
route.tip: These are the only lv 60+ normal mobs on Victoria, but they are slow. Mobs lv 62+ use timed respawns (Wild Kargo about every 2 min), so EXP/hr is poor and these maps are better for loot. Most guides say pure-EXP players should stay on Wraith, Malady or Forgotten Hollow maps.

These are the highest-level normal mobs in the game, but only 2-5 of each per map, with 30s-2m respawns. Both are ice-weak and lightning-resistant. This is a party or loot spot, not efficient solo EXP.

route.map: No dedicated map. Repeat the best EXP/hr map you can one-shot (Wraith lines, Forest of Evil II, Forgotten Hollow after Nov 18) or party-grind
route.monsters: Wraith, Malady, Dark Stone Golem; Rotten Mushroom and Sporewood from Nov 18
route.tip: Victoria Island has no lv 80+ training mobs. The community advice is to track EXP/hr yourself and choose by kill speed, not monster level.

route.map: Same as 80-90. Practically a wall at launch
route.tip: Per meowdb's EXP table, lv 90 needs 11.9M EXP, lv 95 needs 488M, and lv 99 needs 9.48B. Don't promise readers a route to 100. Content for these levels (Ossyria, 3rd job) is not out yet.

route.map: Forgotten Hollow (from Nov 18): Forgotten Entrance III, The End of Fleeting Light, Forbidden Entrance, Perilous Descent III, Another Sanctuary
route.monsters: Glowshroom 39, Raffle 40, Golden Stirge 42, Aqumander 43, Echopus 45, Rafflesia 47, Duskmander 50, Myewood 54, Rotten Mushroom 56, Sporewood 59
route.tip: Not live until Nov 18. I/L: lightning on Aqumander/Echopus, ice on Duskmander. F/P: fire on Raffle/Rafflesia/Myewood/Sporewood, and avoid poison. Clerics: Rotten Mushroom/Sporewood are undead. Warriors: Myewood and Sporewood ranged attacks hit hard. meowdb's Fighter and Cleric guides use these maps from 60 to 70 and beyond.

classNotes.note: Melee-friendly maps: Pig Beach, Construction Site, Wild Boar Land, Burnt Land (Fire Boar), Croko/Drake maps. The class training map at 30 is Warrior's Rocky Mountain (Fire Boars, Lupins). Fighter guide route: Line 1 Area 1 (30) -> Ant Tunnel II/III (35) -> Ant Tunnel Park (40) -> Burnt Land I/III (45) -> Monkey Forest II (50) -> Forest of Evil II (55) -> Perilous Descent III / End of Fleeting Light (60-70, Forgotten Hollow).

Undead maps are the Cleric's niche: Zombie Mushroom, Jr. Wraith, Zombie Lupin, Wraith, Rotten Mushroom and Sporewood all take Heal damage. Malady and Dark Stone Golem are only holy-weak. Fairies resist holy. Buy Orange and Lemon for MP (about 1 MP per meso), not Blue Potion. Cleric guide: Line 1 Area 1 (30) -> Ant Tunnel II (41) -> Line 1 Area 2 (50) -> Tree Dungeon FUN IX (60) -> Forgotten Entrance III (70).

In Classic, elemental weakness and resistance are half as strong, and magic can miss. I/L: Copper Drake (ice-weak), Clang (lightning bonus), Wraith Line 2 Area 3. Taurus mobs are ice-weak but lightning-resistant. F/P: fire on Forgotten Hollow plants. Poison is resisted by many lv 47+ mobs and by Jr. Balrog.
Ranged attacks favor flying Stirges (18-23) and Lorang/Clang beaches. The class training map at 30 is Ant Tunnel For Bowman (Evil Eyes, Zombie Mushrooms).

Assassin guide route: Transfer Area / Dangerous Steam (30) -> Ant Tunnel II (35) -> Ant Tunnel Park / Deep Ant Tunnel II (40-49) -> Tree Dungeon FUN IX / Burnt Land IV (50-59) -> Monkey Forest II (60-65) -> Forest of Evil II (70). Budget for star recharges. The class training map at 30 is Thief's Construction Site (Blue Mushrooms, Cold Eyes).

partyQuests.name: Kerning City PQ (First Time Together)
partyQuests.levels: 21+ (no upper cap in Classic; the original capped at 30). Best value around 21-30.
partyQuests.where: Lakelis, Kerning City (near the sewer entrance). Channels 3-7 only.
partyQuests.notes: Exactly 4 to enter, 30-minute limit. Multiple parties can run at once, death doesn't end the run, and King Slime has 16,820 HP (about double pre-BB) and gives 2,400 EXP. The bonus room has Horny/Green Mushrooms. Squishy Shoes (lv 28) can drop. Players report about half a level per run at Lv 21-22 and 30-40% of a level at Lv 25, in about 35 minutes with the bonus room. One-time quest Proof of Companionship gives 1,870 EXP.

partyQuests.notes: Limited event, mid-November to early December 2026.

partyQuests.notes: Arrives Dec 9 2026. Details are not published yet.

quests.why: Takes you to about lv 8. Rewards Eggs, starter gear and The Green Relaxer chair (Maple Island only, 30 HP / 10s). It cannot be done after you leave.

quests.why: Costs 1,000 mesos to start. The chain pays roughly 7,400 EXP, White Potions or food, and boots or gloves.

quests.name: Citizenship greetings / Citizenship quests
quests.why: About 7,600 EXP for the greetings. Citizenship grade gives 5-25% off shops and taxis and up to 50% off storage. Grade 2 unlocks housing. 86 citizenship quests exist across Henesys and Kerning.

quests.name: Jane and the Mushroom
quests.why: About 1,600-2,000 EXP plus a random Intermediate (60%) weapon attack scroll.

quests.name: Mystery of Niora Hospital / Stranger's Request
quests.why: About 4,850 EXP, 20 Blue Potions, and the Old Raggedy Cape (capes aren't sold in NPC shops).

quests.name: What Shumi Lost
quests.why: 20,160 EXP, 12,222 mesos, 30 Blue Potions, 30 Mana Elixirs, and 23 return scrolls.

quests.name: Last Material Delivery for Building a New House (Ronnie)
quests.where: Ellinia; kill 50 Cold Eyes in Wild Kargo's Area / Sanctuary Entrance
quests.why: Quest EXP that pairs with Cold Eye training.

tips.tip: Leave Maple Island only after you finish all of its quests. The boat is one-way (lv 7, 300 mesos).
Ride the taxi to your job town before 1st job, because Beginners get 90% off taxis.
HP potions: Red Potion, Meat, Apple, Egg and Fried Chicken are the best value (about 2 HP per meso). Orange Potion is fine. Skip White Potions.
MP potions: buy Orange or Lemon (about 1 MP per meso) instead of Blue Potion (about 0.91 MP per meso). Mina in Lith Harbor sells Meat and Lemons.
Always carry a Return Scroll - Nearest Town (400 mesos). There is no cab back out of the Ant Tunnel.

Starter weapons: Steel Pipe (warrior, 3,000, Lith Harbor), Wooden Wand/Staff (mage, 3,000, Ellinia), War Bow/Crossbow (5,000, Henesys), Triangular Zamadar 3,000 or Garnier 5,000 (thief, Kerning). A Wooden Club (19 W.ATK) is available at character creation.

Money: don't vendor quest items or ETC/ores. Crafting opens at lv 10 (six professions, 290 recipes usable at launch). Gloves and capes only come from drops, crafting, quests or players, so they sell well. Duplicate early weapons vendor for 1,500-2,500 mesos.

Death penalty: dying costs about 10% of the EXP for your next level at base LUK (NiaMeowDB's model; more LUK trims it a little, about 6% at 20 LUK). You can't de-level, and there's no EXP loss in towns. Nexon hasn't published the formula.
Character creation: you assign 25 stat points yourself (no dice rerolls), 5 AP per level, and 1st job does not reset AP. An AP Reset Scroll (7,000 NX) resets every stat, including HP and MP.
Magicians advance at lv 10, not lv 8 as in pre-BB. All jobs get 1st job at 10 and 2nd at 30. There is no 3rd job at launch.

Combat changes vs pre-BB: the main AoE skills (Slash Blast, Rush, Iron Arrow, Arrow Bomb, Poison Breath, Thunder Bolt) hit 6 targets, accuracy scales with level, magic can miss, everyone can crit, elemental modifiers are halved, the damage cap is 99,999, and Holy Symbol no longer boosts EXP.

Party EXP bonus (NiaMeowDB's model; Nexon hasn't published numbers): about +10-15% for 2 players, +20-30% for 3, +30-45% for 4, up to +55% for 6. To keep getting party EXP you have to attack, get hit or use a skill on the same map at least every 10 seconds.

A mob is worth training on if you can kill it in 1-2 hits. Mobs 5+ levels above you are hard to hit, and mobs 5+ below give poor EXP. Map capacity scales with players present (75% of spawns solo, 100% at 6 players).
Chair: if you skipped The Green Relaxer, buy the Sky-blue Wooden Chair from Mina in Lith Harbor (1,000 mesos, same regen).
Accuracy is the real wall: in Founder's Access, players trained 4-8 levels above the monsters they hunted (Lorang at 42+, Cold Eye at 43+, Drake at 48+). If you miss a lot, drop to an easier map.

unverified: The 'shortened' Mushmom / Jr. Balrog timers could NOT be confirmed. Metaroad says bosses respawn hourly and Jr. Balrog every 3 h, which is LONGER than the 30 min of the first closed test. No source compares them to pre-BB timers.
The level cap of 100 is stated by meowdb's release page, but Metaroad says no launch cap was announced and the EXP table extends to 120. Treat 100 as likely, not certain.
The lv 90-99 EXP values (x2.1 per level, 9.48B for lv 99) come only from meowdb's table. Verify in game before publishing, since this could be a data artifact or a deliberate soft cap.
Death EXP loss: NiaMeowDB models it as (5 + 20/LUK)% of your next-level EXP (10% at 4 LUK). Nexon hasn't confirmed it.
There is no community-tested route for levels 70-100. Every source stops at 55-70. Entries for 80-100 are inference.
Exact location of Shade not found.
Forgotten Hollow: one source (Metaroad) lists it as available at launch. Meowdb's roadmap says it opens Nov 18. Use Nov 18.
EXP/hr numbers on meowdb and maplestory.quest are theoretical ceilings (every mob killed on spawn), not real rates.

Hour's 'General Training Guide' on meowdb's forum mixes in pre-BB content (Aqua Road, Lorang PQ, Orbis PQ, 'Drake Cave', Sleepywood Tauromacis as an 80-90 spot). Use it only for the Victoria entries that other sources confirm.
KPQ daily entry limits and full-run EXP are not published.
